page.overview:
Who is Star Bright?

Star Bright is the placeholder name of a male unicorn with a gray coat, two-tone pale blue mane, amber eyes, and a cutie mark of a telescope.

Star Bright is identical to "Sightseer" in all but pony kind and eye color, shares his tail style, coat and eye colors, cutie mark, and occasionally neckwear with "Star Gazer", shares his mane and tail style, cutie mark, and sometimes eye color with Starry Eyes, shares his design with Royal Pin, "Ponet", "Poppycock", and S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Stallion #4, shares his mane and tail style with Compass Star and "The Tenth Doctor / Doctor Whooves #3", shares his tail style and eye color with Perfect Pace, "Raggedy Doctor", S04E19 Unnamed Earth Stallion #1, and "Infinity", and shares his tail style with "Emerald Beacon", Madden, and S04E17 Unnamed Earth Stallion #4.

Star Bright first appears in Sweet and Elite as a spectator at the Wonderbolts Derby. He appears at Applejack's send-off party in The Last Roundup, in Ponyville when Cerberus appears in It's About Time, and at the second wedding ceremony in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2.

In Just for Sidekicks, either Star Bright or "Sightseer" appears on the Ponyville-bound Friendship Express.
